# UDF Çevirici (UDF Converter)

> A free, open source web tool that converts PDF files into UDF, the document
> format used by UYAP, Türkiye's National Judiciary Informatics System. The
> conversion runs entirely in the visitor's browser: no file is uploaded to any
> server, and the page works offline once loaded.

Each PDF page is rendered in the browser at 200 DPI and embedded into the UDF
document as a full-page image, so the output looks identical to the source PDF.
The result opens in the UYAP Doküman Editörü and can be filed through UYAP.

- Price: free, no account, no installation, no usage limit.
- Privacy: files never leave the visitor's device; nothing is sent to a server.
- Input: PDF only, one file at a time. Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.
- Output: a .udf file whose text is not editable, because pages are embedded as images.
- Word documents: export to PDF first (File → Save As → PDF), then convert that PDF.
- Very large PDFs (hundreds of pages) can exhaust browser memory; split them first.
- Not affiliated with UYAP or e-Devlet.

The same conversion is published on npm as `uyap-udf` (`npm install uyap-udf`,
then `convertPdfBufferToUdf`), requiring no system dependencies since PDF
rendering uses PDFium via WebAssembly. `convertPdfBufferToUdf` returns
`{ ok: true, udf }` or `{ ok: false, error }` instead of throwing.

## Docs

- [PDF'ten UDF'ye Çevirme](https://halitsever.github.io/uyap-pdf/): the converter in Turkish, with steps, privacy notes and FAQ
- [PDF to UDF Converter](https://halitsever.github.io/uyap-pdf/en/): the same page in English
- [Library README](https://github.com/halitsever/uyap-pdf/blob/main/Readme.md): install and API of the `uyap-udf` Node library
